professionalSummary: Product Owner with four years of experience leading savings feature development, coordinating with core-banking vendors, ensuring compliance approvals, and reporting outcomes to product committees.
experienceHighlights: Interviewed 22 members and translated findings into backlog items for a round‑up savings feature.
Coordinated sprint planning between online‑banking team and core‑banking vendor integration engineers via a shared dependency log.
Led production release of round‑up savings on 15 April 2023, following change advisory board approval.
Sent rate‑sheet and disclosure updates to compliance officer for review before release.
Authored savings section of quarterly digital report presented to product committee.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Post‑launch review for round‑up savings, including CAB reference CAB‑0419, production release date, enrollment counts for first 90 days, and defect resolution dates.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience with member research, vendor coordination, production release, compliance review, and quarterly reporting. They do not provide evidence of experience with other savings or deposit features beyond the round‑up savings feature, nor do they confirm ongoing engagement with a product committee beyond the single quarterly report.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Product Owner, Savings and Deposits role.

evidence.text: Interviewed 22 members about saving towards goals and turned the recurring themes into backlog items for a round‑up savings feature, ordered by how often each theme came up.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of member research and backlog translation.

evidence.text: Coordinated sprint planning between the online‑banking team and the core‑banking vendor's integration engineers through a shared dependency log reviewed each week, and escalated two vendor delays to the vendor's account manager.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of coordination with vendor and internal engineering.

evidence.text: Led the production release of round‑up savings on 15 April 2023, five days after change advisory board approval; before that, the feature ran as a member‑panel pilot with 300 volunteers in the UAT environment.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of production release with change‑board approval.

evidence.text: Sent every rate‑sheet and disclosure update to the compliance officer for review before scheduling it, and filed the approval emails with the release record.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of compliance review before release.

evidence.text: Wrote the savings section of the quarterly digital report, which the head of digital presented to the product committee.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of quarterly reporting to product committee.

supportedClaims.claim: Product Owner with four years of experience leading savings feature development, coordinating with core‑banking vendors, ensuring compliance approvals, and reporting outcomes to product committees.
supportedClaims.witness: Interviewed 22 members about saving towards goals and turned the recurring themes into backlog items for a round‑up savings feature, ordered by how often each theme came up.

humanReviewChecklist: Verify that the candidate has experience with other savings or deposit features beyond round‑up savings.
Confirm ongoing engagement with the product committee beyond the single quarterly report.

The evidence establishes the candidate’s experience with member research, vendor coordination, production release, compliance review, and quarterly reporting. Gaps exist only in the breadth of savings/deposit feature experience and ongoing product committee engagement, which should be clarified in interview.
